layers.content: No fairy dust. No magic plan. Just standards, structure and work. Lose fat, build muscle and become the kind of person who stops folding when life gets uncomfortable.
This is coaching for people who are done negotiating with their excuses. The work is simple. The standards are not.
I DON'T COACH FROM A SCRIPT. I COACH FROM THE WAR.

I've lived the battle with weight, discipline, food, confidence and starting again. So when I coach you, I'm not selling you motivational fairy dust. I'm giving you structure, standards and the uncomfortable truth you need to hear.
✦  Training that respects your body but refuses to baby your excuses.
✦  Nutrition that works in real life, not fantasy-land meal prep prison.
✦  Accountability, standards and honest coaching when your motivation disappears.
COACHING THAT DOESN'T LET YOU HIDE.
Pick the level of support you need. Training, nutrition, mindset and accountability, built around your actual life, not some pretend influencer routine.
A proper training structure that evolves as you get stronger. No random workouts. No gym wandering.
Meal-by-meal help, macros, habits and supplement guidance without the diet cult nonsense.
Training, food, mindset and WhatsApp accountability. For people who know they need the full kick up the arse.
